name: semrush
description: Connect Semrush to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Semrush MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Semrush to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with sEO and traffic data using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Semrush workspace.
Find anything in Semrush that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review sEO and traffic data in Semrush.
